$comment: Intent -> skill routing table added to every prompt by user-prompt-submit.mjs. Keep it in sync with the routing table in the root CLAUDE.md (same skills; tests/routing-table.test.mjs checks it). keywords match whole words, case-insensitive; patterns are case-insensitive regex sources. A prompt that matches nothing gets the default route. A skill without .claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md (or a recipe file that does not exist) is shown as not built yet.

default.intent: any business scenario with no more specific match

routes.intent: any business scenario ("we need..."), a BRD, a use-case workbook, a DGA screenshot or a Figma frame
a new business area, record type or module
a new API action or endpoint
a new permission or access rule
a new status, transition or approval step
a new lookup or reference list
a time limit, deadline or SLA
testing, verifying or investigating one use case end to end (UC id, High Level Scenarios workbook)
turning a PRD into a phased implementation plan (tracer bullets, tracked in plans/)
a PRD and its implementation plan in one go
removing noise comments from one class or file without changing code
executing a planned unit of work or a plan phase
